description: 長住飯店或短租公寓時，與房東或管理員溝通。包含詢問租約條件、押金、水電與清潔規定，討論居家設備問題。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm interested in renting your apartment for a month. Could you clarify what's included in the monthly rate?
sentences.zh: 嗨，我有興趣租您的公寓一個月。可以請您說明月租金包含哪些項目嗎？
sentences.tips: 提出要求時，Could you...? 或 Is it possible to...? 比直接命令（Fix this!）更禮貌，也更容易獲得正面回應。

sentences.en: Certainly. The rate includes all utilities—electricity, water, gas, and high-speed internet.
sentences.zh: 當然。租金包含所有水電瓦斯費——電、水、瓦斯和高速網路。

keywords.zh: 水電瓦斯等公共事業費用

sentences.tips: 長期租屋前，親自參觀並確認附近生活機能，如超市、交通等，以確保日常生活的便利性。

sentences.en: That's good. What about the security deposit and cleaning arrangements?
sentences.zh: 那很好。那押金和清潔安排呢？
sentences.tips: 簽租約前，確認 utilities included?（水電費是否含在租金內）及 furnished?（是否含家具），以免入住後有爭議。

sentences.en: We require a security deposit equal to one month's rent, refundable after check-out if there's no damage. Cleaning is done weekly, included in the rent.
sentences.zh: 我們要求押金等同一個月租金，退房時若無損壞即可退還。每週會有清潔服務，包含在租金內。

grammar_highlights.title: 詢問費用包含項目：What's included in the rent?
grammar_highlights.description: 在決定租房前，務必問清楚租金包含哪些費用（如水電、網路、清潔費），避免後續產生意外支出。
grammar_highlights.example_en: What's included in the rent? Are council taxes included?
grammar_highlights.example_zh: 租金包含哪些項目？市政稅包含在內嗎？

grammar_highlights.title: 確認規則與責任：Are pets allowed? / Who is responsible for...?
grammar_highlights.description: 了解物業的具體規則（如寵物、吸菸）和各項事務的責任歸屬（如維修、付帳單），是順利長住的關鍵。
grammar_highlights.example_en: Who is responsible for maintaining the garden?

grammar_highlights.title: 討論合約與程序：Can I see the agreement? / What's the procedure?
grammar_highlights.description: 在簽署任何文件前，要求先看合約內容，並了解入住、退房及緊急狀況的處理程序，保障自身權益。
grammar_highlights.example_en: Could you explain the early termination procedure in the contract?
grammar_highlights.example_zh: 可以請您解釋一下合約中的提前終止程序嗎？
